audit_type: K-SERIES FULL GAP AUDIT - DESIGNED vs IMPLEMENTED

summary.primary_reason: K has persistent backend models, CRUD endpoints, provider-gated HTTP calls, API-key injection, and module registration, but the complete product-to-AI-to-SERP-to-risk-to-export workflow is not implemented.

capability_matrix.as_designed: Product records should hold complete product knowledge, support create/edit/review/archive, and persist canonical business data for downstream P/GMC/SEO use.

implemented: Persistent SQLAlchemy table family exists for products, attributes, translations, keywords, risk terms, research runs, AI events, versions, media assets, and review items.
Backend exposes list/create/detail/update/archive endpoints for products and patch/read endpoints for attributes, keywords, and risk terms.
Frontend /products page supports product creation, list loading, selection, and minimal detail display.
gaps: Product DTOs and UI expose only a subset of model fields; pricing, inventory, material, unit, category, SEO, GMC, media, and many logistics fields are not editable in the main UI.
Review item model exists but no review item API/UI flow is wired for product approval.
Archive exists in backend but is not exposed in the current product UI.
Operation log actions are declared in the module manifest but K service comments state operation_logs are intentionally left as a future optional hook.

capability_matrix.as_designed: DeepSeek should structure raw product input into canonical K product fields and create reviewable AI output.

implemented: Backend endpoint POST /k/products/{product_id}/enrich/deepseek requires module execution readiness with key alias deepseek.
Endpoint performs an HTTP POST to the configured provider URL and stores provider output in deepseek_structured_output_json and k_product_knowledge_ai_events.
Product review_status is advanced to ai_structured.
gaps: No DeepSeek UI trigger is present on /products.
No prompt template/version or DeepSeek-specific schema validator is implemented in K runtime.
Provider output is stored as JSON but not mapped into canonical product, attribute, keyword, category, image, SEO, or GMC fields.
The endpoint calls a generic configured provider URL; the code does not prove it is the DeepSeek public API.

capability_matrix.as_designed: SERP should execute real market searches, extract competitors and keywords, persist keyword candidates, and feed optimization/review.

implemented: POST /k/serp/search requires execution gate and key alias serp.
The endpoint posts to the configured provider URL and parses organic_results/results/items into a typed SERP response.
SERP provider output is stored on a research run row.
Frontend has a SERP trigger panel that calls /k/serp/search.
gaps: POST /k/keyword-research/start only creates a queued research run; it does not execute SERP or a worker pipeline.
SERP keyword strings returned by the provider are not inserted into k_product_knowledge_keywords.
Frontend SERP panel uses hardcoded default product choices and is not tied to the selected product list row.
No persisted competitor entity/table or SERP result detail UI exists.

capability_matrix.as_designed: Risk terms should be detected, reviewed by humans, confirmed or ignored, and block/clean unsafe product output before export.

implemented: Risk term table and product-scoped backend patch/read endpoints exist.
K20 compatibility endpoints support global risk list, create, update, and ignore.
POST /k/products/{product_id}/risk-filter calls an AI provider and stores returned risk_terms as candidate risk rows.
Frontend risk UI supports manual creation, severity/category filtering, edit, resolve, and ignore.
gaps: Risk-filter AI endpoint has no UI trigger.
Risk review is not bound to product approval status, export gate, or approval records.
Global /k/risks list is not scoped by product in the UI.
Duplicate risk detection and canonical risk severity schema are weak; risk_type is encoded as a free-form string.

capability_matrix.as_designed: AI should refine SERP keyword candidates, classify intent, rank/select useful keywords, reject risky terms, and persist optimized keyword decisions.

implemented: Research run model reserves chatgpt_filter_summary_json and claude_filter_summary_json fields.
Frontend keyword source types include K17 and K18 labels.
gaps: No backend endpoint implements AI keyword filtering/optimization.
No prompt-to-AI optimization pipeline exists for SERP keyword ranking.
No optimized keyword persistence path connects SERP output to k_product_knowledge_keywords.
No UI control exists for AI keyword optimization.

capability_matrix.as_designed: K should normalize product units such as dimensions and weight for marketplaces and downstream product pages.

implemented: Product and attribute models reserve dimensions_json, weight_json, package dimensions/weight JSON, and attribute_unit fields.
gaps: No unit conversion service was found.
No conversion endpoint was found.
No UI exists for unit normalization or metric/imperial conversion.
No downstream mapping applies normalized units for GMC/P/SEO output.

capability_matrix.as_designed: K should manage product images, gallery assets, selection/review state, and downstream image metadata.

implemented: Media asset table exists with product, role, status, review_status, storage_provider, object_key, placeholder URL, dimensions, file size, source, and metadata fields.
Backend exposes GET /k/media and POST /k/media for metadata records.
gaps: No image upload endpoint or storage integration exists in K.
POST /k/media only accepts file_url_placeholder and metadata; it does not manage object storage.
No image management UI is present on /products.
No image review/selection workflow is exposed.

capability_matrix.as_designed: Approved K product knowledge should export or hand off structured output to P-series, GMC, and SEO pipelines.

implemented: Workflow registry declares active K workflows for to_p_series, to_gmc, and to_seo.
Result normalization has generic K/P/SEO family adaptation rules.
Product model reserves SEO and merchant category fields.
gaps: No K export endpoint for P/GMC/SEO was found.
No UI export action exists.
No runtime n8n dispatch/handoff is called from K endpoints.
No generated P/GMC/SEO artifact or persisted output table was found.

capability_matrix.as_designed: K provider execution should use organization-scoped API key bindings and never expose raw secrets to frontend.

implemented: API key records and module bindings exist.
Keys are stored as encrypted envelopes and injected server-side as Authorization headers.
K execution endpoints request aliases serp, deepseek, and ai_provider through require_module_execution_ready.
Generic API key orchestration endpoints exist for owners.
gaps: No provider-specific schema/health check proves a bound URL is a real SERP/DeepSeek provider.
K n8n downstream binding is declared but not used by K runtime.
K UI does not surface provider readiness directly inside the product workflow.

capability_matrix.as_designed: K execution should pass module control, org context, API key binding, permission, and high-risk approval gates before external execution.

implemented: Provider-style K endpoints call require_module_execution_ready.
Execution gate resolves org context, creates/reads module control state, blocks disabled modules, resolves API key aliases, and emits gate events.
K endpoints separately require K permissions.
gaps: Execution gate is not used for basic CRUD endpoints, which is acceptable for non-provider operations but means module control is not universal across K.
High-risk risk_filter action is declared as approval-required in adapter metadata, but the actual /risk-filter endpoint does not request or validate an approval record.
Adapter action contracts say execution_type is no_op while K router performs direct HTTP provider calls, creating a contract/runtime mismatch.
Operation-log requirements are declared but K service does not write operation logs.
